rationale: The review is thorough, correctly classifies the repository (Desktop/Electron, not Tauri), and grounds every material claim in inspectable paths/symbols/line numbers. It distinguishes current implementation from stale documentation (ARCHITECTURE.md/TYPESCRIPT.md historical layout; CLAUDE.md contextIsolation/sandbox conflict; IPC.md accurate) and relies on code, not intent, for decisions. Friction is concrete (5-6 hop file-workflow chain, three window-identity forms, dual command system, any-shimmed engine), quality attributes are ranked with trade-offs and verification, three options are compared including current shape, the recommendation (consolidate existing seams rather than add speculative abstractions) follows from the evidence, and the migration is incremental, observable, and reversible with grep/typecheck-verifiable exit criteria. Two minor factual inaccuracies (ipcMain.emit count in file.ts: 20 vs ~30; CommandId already existing in common/commands/constants) do not alter the recommendation and do not block the accuracy gate. All nine dimensions earn full credit: total 18/18.
